extract_cpp_docstrings: run mkdoc.py on C++ header files to extract Doxygen comments into Python binding docstrings
process_comment_doxygen_to_markdown: process a C++ Doxygen comment string and convert it to Markdown formatted text
sanitize_name_for_docstring: sanitize a C++ symbol name including operators and templates into a valid docstring variable name
extract_ast_nodes_recursively: recursively walk a Clang AST node tree to collect documentation from classes, functions, and methods
run_mkdoc_cli: run mkdoc.py with include flags and a list of C++ header files to generate a docstring C++ header
